title: Professional Tip: Orienting Cleanout Fittings Correctly
description: Cleanouts are vital access points for drain maintenance, but their orientation determines their effectiveness. Always install cleanout wye fittings oriented in the direction of waste flow. Installing a cleanout backwards makes it nearly impossible to guide a drain snake or inspection camera downstream toward the main line. Proper directional fitting selection ensures smooth tool insertion, faster troubleshooting, and prevents snake cables from binding during drain cleaning service calls. Always verify cleanout accessibility and clearance before finalizing pipe assembly.
